name: Do I need a real estate agent to buy an off-market property?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a real estate agent to buy an off-market property?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible to find off-market properties independently, working with a real estate agent, especially one with extensive local connections like Kelby Contreras, can be highly beneficial. Agents often have exclusive access to pocket listings and a network of owners considering selling privately. This is a first-party insight, as agents at Realty ONE Group Evolution leverage their established relationships across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties to uncover properties not visible to the general public, streamlining your search.
acceptedAnswer.description: A real estate agent can be very beneficial for finding off-market properties, as they often have exclusive access and local networks.
